description: List ad groups in an account, optionally filtered to one campaign, with budget and bid fields in USD. Ad groups hold the budget, bid, and targeting that update_budget, update_bid, and update_targeting change. Use get_ad_group for a single known id.

account_id.description: Ad account id. Falls back to REDDIT_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID.

campaign_id.description: Only return ad groups in this campaign.

name: get_ad_groups
